lean.statement: theorem exists_functorial_object_injective_resolution {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] (J : C ⥤ C) (η : 𝟭 C ⟶ J) (hη : ∀ A : C, Mono (η.app A)) (hJ : ∀ A : C, Injective (J.obj A)) : ∃ (E : C ⥤ CochainComplex C ℕ) (ε : (CochainComplex.single₀ C) ⟶ E), (∀ A : C, QuasiIso (ε.app A)) ∧ (∀ (A B : C), E.map (0 : A ⟶ B) = 0) ∧ IsZero (E.obj (0 : C)) ∧ (∀ (A : C) (n : ℕ), Injective ((E.obj A).X n))

title: Functorial objectwise injective resolutions
statement: For an abelian category C, a functorial monomorphic embedding η : 𝟭 C ⟶ J into injective objects admits a functor E : C ⥤ CochainComplex C ℕ and a natural augmentation ε : single₀ C ⟶ E such that each ε.app A is a quasi-isomorphism, E maps every zero morphism to zero, E.obj 0 is a zero complex, and every term (E.obj A).X n is injective.

proof.text: Normalize J at the zero object using kernel universal properties, obtaining a functor preserving zero objects and zero morphisms and a natural monomorphic embedding into injectives. Recursively take cokernels of the embeddings and use their universal properties to define the functorial maps and differentials. The resulting augmented nonnegative complexes are exact, and all their terms are injective by the retract argument. Package these complexes and augmentations as E and ε.
